<h2 class="section-heading">Research Areas</h2>


<div class="research-row image-layout">

<div class="research-image">
<img src="images/research-corpus.png" alt="Corpus-informed language research">
</div>

<div class="row-content">
<h2>Corpus Linguistics</h2>
<p>I use corpus-based and computational approaches to examine language use across English and Korean, with interests in learner language, academic discourse, and disciplinary communication. I am also interested in developing corpus-informed resources for language teaching and research and in extending these approaches to less commonly taught languages.</p>
</div>

</div>


<div class="research-row image-layout">

<div class="research-image">
<img src="images/research-development.png" alt="Learner language and development">
</div>

<div class="row-content">
<h2>Second Language Acquisition</h2>
<p>I investigate how second language learners develop and use language across proficiency levels, time, tasks, and modalities, with attention to developmental patterns, variability, and individual learner trajectories.</p>
</div>

</div>


<div class="research-row image-layout">

<div class="research-image">
<img src="images/research-ai-learning.png" alt="AI-mediated language learning and assessment">
</div>

<div class="row-content">
<h2>AI-Mediated Language Learning & Assessment</h2>
<p>I investigate how generative AI, speech technologies, and other computational tools can mediate language learning, feedback, interaction, and assessment.</p>
</div>

</div>


<div class="research-row image-layout">

<div class="research-image">
<img src="images/research-critical-ai.png" alt="Critical and research-informed AI use">
</div>

<div class="row-content">
<h2>Critical & Research-Informed AI Use</h2>
<p>I explore how AI can be used critically and responsibly in language education, with an emphasis on SLA theory, evidence-based practice, and the evaluation and verification of AI-generated feedback.</p>
</div>

</div>
